fires.name: NASA FIRMS · Suomi NPP VIIRS C2

model.name: Seeded surface-wind advection
model.release: All selected detections release an equal-weight pulse at the start time. Detection does not establish fuel type or continued burning.
model.limitations: 10 m winds, coarse grid, no plume rise or chemistry. Relative particle influence is not PM2.5, AQI, exposure dose or source attribution.
